tests.question: How many films are in the database?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film

tests.question: How many customers are there?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer

tests.question: How many actors are there?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM actor

tests.question: List the titles of all PG rated films.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG' ORDER BY title LIMIT 100

tests.question: How many films have a PG-13 rating?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

tests.question: List films with a rental rate of 0.99.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 0.99 ORDER BY title LIMIT 100

tests.question: How many films have a rental rate greater than 3?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_rate > 3

tests.question: Show film titles with their category names.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT f.title, c.name AS category FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category AS c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id ORDER BY f.title, c.name LIMIT 100

tests.question: List actors and the titles of films they appeared in.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, f.title FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, f.title LIMIT 100

tests.question: How many films are in each category?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

tests.question: What is the total payment revenue per category?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

tests.question: How many rentals has each customer made?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id LIMIT 100

tests.question: Show the five customers with the most rentals.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer AS c JOIN rental AS r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY rental_count DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5

tests.question: What are the five most expensive films to rent?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT title, rental_rate FROM film ORDER BY rental_rate DESC, title LIMIT 5

tests.question: Show the five most recent payments and their amounts.
tests.gold_sql: SELECT payment_id, customer_id, amount, payment_date FROM payment ORDER BY payment_date DESC, payment_id DESC LIMIT 5

tests.question: How many rentals started during 2005?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= TIMESTAMP '2005-01-01' AND rental_date < TIMESTAMP '2006-01-01'

tests.question: How much payment revenue was collected in August 2005?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= TIMESTAMP '2005-08-01' AND payment_date < TIMESTAMP '2005-09-01'

tests.question: How many rentals were returned in July 2005?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE return_date >= TIMESTAMP '2005-07-01' AND return_date < TIMESTAMP '2005-08-01'

tests.question: What is the average payment amount for each customer?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, AVG(p.amount) AS average_payment FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id LIMIT 100

tests.question: How many copies of each film are in inventory?
tests.gold_sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY f.film_id LIMIT 100
